title: Loop generation list
summary: Use for to create each item in the click listener. Each round uses createElement to create a li, sets the text and then adds it to the list. Clear the old project before rebuilding.
tasks: After clicking #make-list, it loops from 1 to 5, creating a li each time and adding it to #days.
display "Day 1" to "Day 5" in sequence. On the second click, the list still only has five items.
hint: If ten items appear after the second click, use list.replaceChildren() at the beginning of the click listener to clear the old items. Each cycle creates a new li and writes the number of the day.
goal: Creates a five-day plan list after clicking the button, and regenerates the same list when clicked repeatedly.

example.note: After clicking "display locker", the page generates three cabinet numbers from 101 to 103. Clicking again will replace the old list with the same batch of items.
